shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html vite.config.ts tsconfig.json && echo "----- ROUTING TOP" && sed -n 1,60p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "----- INSPECT" && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeType useThemeValue Switch Button Icon 2>&1 | head -80 && echo "----- LOCAL DOCS" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/

echo "----- THEME DTS" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/constants.d.ts 2>&1 && echo "----- README theme" && rg -n -i -C 3 'ThemeProvider|useTheme' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -60 && echo "----- TRAPS theming" && rg -n -i -C 6 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150 && echo "----- REF theming ThemeProvider" && rg -n -C 8 'ThemeProvider|useTheme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -150

B=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat $B/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts $B/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts $B/components/theme/useThemeContext.d.ts $B/components/theme/getThemeType.d.ts $B/components/theme/ThemeContext.d.ts $B/components/theme/ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts $B/components/theme/useThemeSettings.d.ts && echo "----- Switch" && cat $B/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && rg -n 'onUpdate|onChange|checked|defaultChecked|content|size|title' $B/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls $B/components/controls 2>/dev/null; echo "----- Button" && rg -n 'view|size|onClick|selected|children' $B/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -30 && echo "----- Icon" && cat $B/components/Icon/Icon.d.ts && echo "----- icons" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | rg -i '^(Sun|Moon)' && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | rg '"version"' && echo "----- Segmented/RadioButton" && ls $B/components | rg -i 'segmented|radio|switch'

B=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && echo "----- ThemeProvider.js" && cat $B/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js && echo "----- ControlProps" && rg -n -A 12 'export interface ControlProps' $B/components/types.d.ts && echo "----- ButtonView" && rg -n 'ButtonView|ButtonSize' $B/components/Button/types.d.ts $B/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head && sed -n 1,40p $B/components/Button/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "----- icons dep?" && rg -n 'icons' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; cat $B/components/theme/useSystemTheme.d.ts
timeout 100 npm install @gravity-ui/icons@^2.23.1 2>&1 | tail -5; rg -n 'icons' package.json

B=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && rg -n "theme|layout|Text'|Card'" $B/components/index.d.ts | head -20; echo "--- Flex"; rg -n 'gap\?|alignItems\?|direction\?|justifyContent\?' $B/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; echo "--- Text"; rg -n "TEXT_VARIANTS|variant\?|color\?" $B/components/Text/Text.d.ts $B/components/Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; rg -n "'header-1'|'body-1'|'subheader-2'" $B/components/Text/text/text.d.ts $B/components/Text/constants.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "--- Card"; rg -n "view\?|type\?|size\?" $B/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; echo "--- body bg"; rg -n -B2 -A4 '^body|\.g-root \{' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/*.css 2>/dev/null | rg -n 'background|color' | head -5
